items.title: ASUS MyASUS Flaw Lets Hackers Escalate to SYSTEM-Level Access
items.description: ASUS has disclosed a high security vulnerability in its MyASUS application that could allow local attackers to escalate their privileges to SYSTEM-level access on affected Windows devices. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2025-59373, carries a high-severity CVSS 4.0 score of 8.5, indicating a significant risk to millions of ASUS computer users worldwide.
